import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}address-cities`;// Get address City
const getAddressCities=async(access_token,params=null)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`},params};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Create new address City
const createAddressCity=async(addressCityData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,addressCityData,config);return response.data;};// update address City
const updateAddressCity=async(addressCityId,addressCityData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+addressCityId,addressCityData,config);return response.data;};// Delete address City
const deleteAddressCity=async(addressCityId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+addressCityId,config);return response.data;};// batch delete address City
const batchDeleteAddressCities=async(addressCityIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",addressCityIds,config);return response.data;};const addressCityService={getAddressCities,createAddressCity,updateAddressCity,deleteAddressCity,batchDeleteAddressCities};export default addressCityService;
